title: The Perfect Cow
description: A cow stands during a professional livestock photography session at an annual cattle show in Verden, Germany. Germany is one of Europe's largest milk producers and the second largest producer of beef on the content.
translated_description: 在德国费尔登举行的一年一度牛展上，一头奶牛在专业牲畜摄影环节中站立着。德国是欧洲最大的牛奶生产国之一，也是欧洲大陆第二大牛肉生产国。
